evidence.ref: warp.evidence/v1 is defined in .warp/evidence.py (validate_plane). A config declares an id and one or more sources, each with an id, a kind from the read-only vocabulary {logs, metrics, traces, read_replica} and NEVER a primary, an access that MUST be read_only, a secret_ref that is a reference (env: or keychain:) and never a raw literal (D4), a non-empty templates list, positive max_rows/rate_max/timeout_ms quotas, and an optional redact list. Configs are homed per-repo under .warp/evidence/*.yaml, a subdirectory the single-level .warp/*.yaml engine glob does not reach, so they stay per-repo like the architecture contract and the incident/remedy records and are never shipped. The illustrative example ships at .warp/examples/evidence-sources-example.yaml (id reference-plane, three sources: logs, metrics, read_replica) and validates clean: python3 .warp/evidence.py .warp/examples/evidence-sources-example.yaml returns 'clean'.

The credential seam is read-only PHYSICS in two layers. Layer 1 (type-level): a ReadOnlyCredential (GRANTS frozenset({'read'})) yields only a ReadHandle via open_read, and the ReadHandle's sole operation is query - neither type carries a write, insert, update, delete, execute, or mutate method, so a write cannot be expressed. There is no open_write on the credential. Layer 2 (seam-level): FakeEvidencePlane.submit_write authorizes a write by the submitting credential's granted role, never by inspecting the op or asking a policy; a write submitted with the responder's read-only credential raises EvidenceWriteRefused naming the credential seam and leaves the store unchanged. NON-VACUITY: WriteCapableCredential (grants read+write, which the responder never holds) applies the same write, so the refusal is the read-only grant, not a disabled store.

selftests: type-level absence 'ReadHandle exposes only query (no write/insert/update/delete/execute/mutate)', 'ReadOnlyCredential yields only a read handle (no open_write/execute/mutate)', 'a read-only credential grants only read'. THE NEGATIVE TEST 'a write with the responder's read-only credential is refused AT THE CREDENTIAL SEAM, store unchanged' (predicate _ev_write_is_refused returns True: EvidenceWriteRefused raised with 'credential seam' in the message AND row_count unchanged). NON-VACUITY 'a write-granted credential DOES apply the same write' (row_count + 1).

The read path is a Broker (not a raw connection). Broker.query enforces, in order: templated shape (only a template the source declares; a free-form or undeclared template refuses 'not a declared template'), rate quota (queries beyond rate_max within the window refuse 'rate quota'), row quota (est_rows over max_rows refuses 'row quota', plus an overload guard on the actual returned rows), and per-query timeout (est_ms over timeout_ms refuses 'timeout'). It then reads through the plane and REDACTS the source's declared sensitive fields (redact_row replaces each with ***redacted*** before the rows enter context), and records EVERY query (allowed or refused) in a QueryAudit carrying source, template, params, decision, and row count.

selftests: positive control 'a declared, in-quota, in-timeout query succeeds'; 'seeded PII never reaches context' (email and ip_address are ***redacted*** in the returned rows, and the raw values user@example.com / 203.0.113.9 appear in no row). Each refusal by name (>0 via _ev_refused): 'a free-form (undeclared-template) query is REFUSED', 'an over-row-cap query is REFUSED (row quota)', 'an over-timeout query is REFUSED (timeout)', 'a query beyond the rate cap is REFUSED (rate quota)'. AUDIT 'every query (allowed or refused) lands in the full audit log' (4 entries: 1 allowed + 3 refused, first decision 'allowed').

The live edge is a fail-loud reference seam. LiveEvidencePlane.connect and .execute_read each raise EvidencePlaneError naming the per-system human-approved enablement act (NG1); no live connection is opened in the gate and a runtime injects a real adapter, mirroring executor.LiveLoop refusing to fabricate a build. All proof is offline against FakeEvidencePlane, which serves the read path in memory. Secret references resolve at the seam (resolve_secret_ref): a raw literal is refused (D4), an env: reference resolves from the injected environment, and a keychain: reference fails loud offline (a live per-system act). The raw secret never surfaces: _ResolvedSecret and ReadOnlyCredential redact the value in repr, and context_view returns secret ***redacted*** (C5).

selftests: 'the live edge fails loud on connect' and 'on read' (EvidencePlaneError naming 'per-system'); 'the fake plane serves the read path offline'; 'a raw-literal secret reference is REFUSED (D4)' ('never a raw literal'); 'an env: reference resolves at the seam and its repr redacts the raw value' (s3cr3t absent from repr); 'a keychain reference fails loud offline' ('live per-system act'); 'a credential's context view and repr redact the secret' (secret == ***redacted***).
